review_candidates.title: Lead Azure Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description We have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Azure Cloud Engineer at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement, based in our Evanston, Illinois, office. The Lead Azure Cloud Engineer serves as a senior technical expert and individual contributor responsible for defining, designing, and advancing enterprise cloud infrastructure strategy and solutions. This role provides technical leadership across complex cloud initiatives, drives cloud architecture standards and best practices, and partners with cross-functional teams to ensure secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective cloud environments. The Lead Azure Cloud Engineer influences technical direction, mentors team members, and leads the implementation of cloud modernization efforts while remaining hands-on in solution design and delivery. The Lead Azure Cloud Engineer also directs the day-to-day technical work of a managed service provider (MSP) engineering team, setting priorities, defining standards of quality, and holding delivery partners accountable to agreed service levels and outcomes. UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) and UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk, created new safety standards and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge. What You’ll Learn And Achieve As the Lead Azure Cloud Engineer, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you: Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise cloud infrastructure solutions across major cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform). Lead and direct an MSP-based technical team — assigning work, reviewing deliverables, coaching engineers, and driving consistent execution against runbooks, SLAs, and engineering standards. Serve as the primary technical point of escalation for MSP-delivered services, partnering with vendor leadership on staffing, onboarding, quality, and continuous improvement. Establish cloud architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices that support organizational scalability, security, and operational excellence. Serve as the technical lead for complex infrastructure projects, providing architectural guidance and influencing technology decisions across multiple teams. Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategies using Terraform as the primary provisioning standard, with CloudFormation where platform-native tooling is required. Build and maintain configuration management and server automation using Ansible, including role design, inventory management, and drift remediation. Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for infrastructure provisioning, configuration deployment, automated testing, policy enforcement, and release automation. Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, implementation standards, and operational procedures usable by both internal staff and MSP partners. Provide mentorship, technical coaching, and knowledge sharing to engineering team members while promoting engineering best practices. Contribute to and/or lead other department specific and cross-functional initiatives. What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement: We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do. People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require. Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good. Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs. Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive. Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are eligible for bonus compensation based on the level of the position. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days. What Makes You a Great Fit While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes: Advanced expertise in cloud platforms, with deep hands-on experience in at least one major provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working familiarity with a second. Strong knowledge of cloud architecture patterns, including high availability, disaster recovery, scalability, and multi-region deployments. Expert proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure as code, including module design, state management, remote backends, and workspace/environment strategy. Advanced understanding of cloud networking, including virtual networks, NSGs, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, load balancing, DNS, and hybrid-cloud connectivity. Strong experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering principles. Deep understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, Zero Trust principles, encryption, compliance frameworks, and governance controls. Ability to analyze complex technical challenges, identify root causes, and implement scalable, long-term solutions. Demonstrated ability to lead, coordinate, and hold accountable for a managed service provider or outsourced engineering team across multiple time zones, including work intake, prioritization, quality review, and performance feedback to vendor leadership. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across multiple teams and levels of the organization. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, establish standards, and guide teams. Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to organizational priorities and objectives. Professional Education And Experience Requirements For The Role Include Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 8 years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or related areas, including responsibility for designing and managing enterprise-scale cloud environments. Minimum 3 years of experience leading complex cloud transformation, migration, modernization, or architecture initiatives. Demonstrated experience serving as a technical lead, subject matter expert, or principal contributor to cloud infrastructure initiatives. About UL Research Institutes And UL Standards & Engagement UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being. To learn more, visit our websites UL.org and ULSE.org. Salary Range $119,260.28-$163,982.88 Pay Type Salary

Bij Cyso Cloud bouwen en beheren we een volledig Europees, GDPR-compliant cloudplatform waar organisaties blindelings op kunnen vertrouwen. Om dat platform stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig te houden, zijn we op zoek naar een Platform Engineer die zich thuis voelt op het snijvlak van operations en development. Cyso ontwerpt, bouwt, beheert en beveiligt 24×7 webapplicatie platformen in onze enterprise cloud en op ons cloud native Cyso Cloud platform. We hebben onze eigen infrastructuur verdeeld over 3 datacenters in Amsterdam en Frankfurt. We geloven in cloud neutrale oplossingen en maken gebruik van cloud tooling en de SRE mindset, óók voor meer traditionele setups. We zijn een team van nieuwsgierige hosting experts, beheren ons eigen netwerk en meer dan 10 miljoen domeinnamen zijn afhankelijk van onze beschikbaarheid. Als Platform Engineer in ons Cloud-team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van onze cloud infrastructuur. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het beheer van onze OpenStack- en Ceph-omgevingen en werkt continu aan automatisering, tooling en integratie. Een groot deel van je tijd gaat op aan performance optimalisatie. Je monitort en beheert de stabiliteit en prestaties van de operationele infrastructuur, en analyseert systeemprestatiegegevens om potentiële knelpunten tijdig te signaleren. Waar je kansen ziet om de prestaties te verbeteren, pak je die op. Je bent medeverantwoordelijk voor de operationele status van het platform en draagt actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe functies en verbeteringen, en je optimaliseert doorlopend onze cloud resources. Je schrijft en valideert softwarecode en bewaakt de beschikbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van functionaliteiten en toepassingen, en implementeert beveiligingsmaatregelen en best practices voor onze cloud infrastructuur. Ook zorg je ervoor dat rapportagetools inzetbaar blijven en dat er goede rapportages worden gemaakt, en analyseer je incidenten om herhaling in de toekomst te voorkomen. Automatisering vormt het derde pijler van je functie Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt automatiseringstools en scripts voor het uitvoeren en beheren van platform en infrastructuurtaken.. Ook implementeer je CI/CD-pipelines, zodat software en updates continu en betrouwbaar geïntegreerd en uitgerold kunnen worden. Bij Cyso is er een mix van snel schakelen en gefocust aan de slag kunnen. Of er nu vanuit kantoor of huis gewerkt wordt, collega’s zijn altijd goed bereikbaar via mail en Slack. Het team is bereikbaar en maakt tijd om te zorgen dat iedereen succesvol aan de slag kan. Je krijgt alle ruimte om te doen wat goed is. Je krijgt het vertrouwen van collega’s dat je goed werk levert en wordt gesteund door het team. Cloud Platform Engineer Jij Bent HBO werk- en denkniveau (Bij voorkeur een afgeronde opleiding in gerelateerd vakgebied, zoals Computerwetenschappen, Informatica, Software Engineering). Ervaren met Linux. Sterk in Python. Ervaren met het beheren en configureren van OpenStack en Ceph. Ervaren met API’s. Bekend met CI/CD. Ervaren met container-technologieën. Ervaren met logging, monitoring en alerting (LMA). Ervaren met Git. Bekend met GO. Ook sluiten we iedere vrijdag af met een vrijblijvende borrel. In het werk wat je doet vinden we kwaliteit belangrijker dan kwantiteit en dat geeft je de kans om veel te oefenen en te spelen met verschillende technieken om tot de beste oplossing voor de vraagstukken voor onze klanten te komen. Wij nemen je serieus, geven ruimte aan je creativiteit en waarderen iedereen om zijn of haar bijdrage, maar we zeggen ook eerlijk en direct waar het op staat. Cyso is een betrokken werkgever. We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our team located in San Diego, CA. Serve as the software/firmware system architect, defining end‑to‑end architectures and allocating functionality between hardware, firmware, and software. Develop and manage systems engineering artifacts related to software and firmware, including requirements, use cases, interface control documents, data/interface definitions, architecture descriptions, technical baselines, and verification and validation plans. Use MBSE and SysML/UML tools to: Capture and decompose system, subsystem, and lower‑level software/firmware requirements. Develop and maintain system models Support design trades and system behavior/performance characterization Provide technical guidance to systems engineering staff and integrated product teams; mentor and support the development of junior systems engineers. Serve as a key technical contributor and present technical content at internal and customer reviews. Software/Firmware Development Team Interactions Lead the definition and creation of documentation of the software/firmware architecture needed for the program. Understand and analyze system‑level requirements and operational use cases. Identify required software/firmware functions and performance characteristics. Define interfaces between software, firmware, hardware, and external systems. Work closely with software and firmware development teams to support their design, implementation, and testing of the software/firmware in accordance with the defined architecture. Ensure developers have clear requirements and interface definitions to facilitate feedback on feasibility, complexity, and implementation risks. Incorporate developer feedback and lessons learned from design and integration into updates of the architecture and requirements. Maintain architectural coherence, traceability, and alignment with system requirements and developer led design. Integration and Test Support Support the development of integration and test plans and procedures for software/firmware and system‑level verification and validation. Focus on requirements verification and validation against the defined architecture, interface verification, and end‑to‑end functional behavior. Feed lessons learned from lab and field testing back into the architecture, requirements, and test plans. Participate in test readiness reviews, anomaly documentation, root‑cause analysis, and resolution. Ensure that architecture, requirements, and test artifacts remain consistent in a digital engineering environment. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Collaborate with program management, software/firmware developers, and other functional teams on design, integration, and test activities. Participate in and present at program design and readiness reviews throughout the lifecycle. Interface with customers to understand needs and communicate technical status. Generate technical documentation and presentations that will be used by other engineering disciplines to support programs, proposals, and internal development opportunities. Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information and comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies; work safely in accordance with established procedures We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. Job Qualifications Typically requires a bachelors degree, masters degree or PhD in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution and progressive engineering experience as follows; twelve or more years of experience with a bachelors degree, ten or more years of experience with a masters degree, or seven or more years with a PhD. May substitute equivalent engineering experience in lieu of education. Significant experience architecting software and firmware for real‑time embedded or mission‑critical systems, including those using microcontrollers and FPGAs. Experience in software/firmware development with a strong understanding of both high‑level and low‑level computer system integration. Understanding of SOSA and MOSA architectural considerations. Experience with communication protocols such as RS‑422, I²C, GigE, SPI, TCP, UDP, JSON‑RPC, Modbus TCP, and MQTT. Experience developing in Linux, Windows, or microcontroller‑based environments. Proven ability to lead complex engineering projects, including systems that undergo formal verification and validation. Strong foundation in engineering principles and practices, with the ability to plan, schedule, and coordinate work to meet program milestones. Ability to quickly understand and apply new concepts in a dynamic environment. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with experience interfacing with customers and cross‑functional. A strong understanding of configuration management and change control. Able to work independently and collaboratively, and to work extended hours when required. Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: Prior experience serving as an Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead or similar technical leadership role. Hands‑on experience integrating complex software/firmware payloads into space, missile defense, or other high‑reliability platforms. Experience designing architectures that meet strict real‑time, safety, or mission‑assurance requirements. Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain a software/firmware architecture model that is actively used by multiple development teams as the single source of truth for interfaces and behavior. Experience support the transition of a system from initial prototype demonstration to an established product line. Experience working on TS/SCI programs supporting contract facility and process requirements. Professional recognition such as: A Professional Engineering (PE) license Publication of original work in engineering journals Presentations of original works at an engineering conference or symposium. Previous experience working with the Department of Defense or other major customers. Job Type: Full-Time Salary Salary range: 118,500 - 207,750

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요 토스증권의 Network Engineer는 Network Security Engineer, IDC Manager, IDC Engineer 등과 함께 Network Engineering Team 에 소속되어 있어요. 대고객, 내부 고객 전반에 대한 시스템을 구축하고 IDC를 관리해요. 금융이나 커머스, 포털, 게임사 등 다양한 분야에서 모인 인프라, 개발 영역의 우수한 팀원들과 협업하고 있어요. '제품에만 집중할 수 있도록 모든 것을 지원한다'라는 목표를 두고, 대규모 트랙픽을 지원할 수 있는 인프라 구축을 위해 노력하고 있어요. 더욱 빠른 제품 출시를 위해 자동화도 추진하고 있어요. 합류하면 함께할 업무예요 토스증권의 모든 네트워크 시스템을 최적의 상태로 관리하고 개선해요. 토스증권의 오피스 네트워크 환경을 구축하고 운영해요. 무중단 서비스 구현을 위해 멀티데이터센터네트워크를 설계하고 구축해요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 3년 이상 네트워크 구축 및 운영 경험이 필요해요. 멀티 데이터센터 연동을 위한 동적라우팅 L3프로토콜 (BGP, OSPF 등) 운영하신 경험이 필요해요. L1~L7 계층의 다양한 네트워크 프로토콜(IP, MAC, TCP, HTTP, SSL, mTLS 등) 동작 원리를 이해하고, 패킷분석을 통해 장애 원인을 파악하고 해결한 경험이 필요해요. 대규모 트래픽 발생되는 환경에서 L4/L7 로드밸런서 운영해 보신 경험이 필요해요. 네트워크 성능 및 상태 지표를 이해하고, SNMP·API·Exporter·Syslog 등을 활용해 데이터 수집 및 알림 체계를 구축·개선한 경험이 필요해요. 스크립트 또는 자동화 도구를 활용해 네트워크 시스템 설정, 상태 점검 등 반복적인 운영 업무를 자동화한 경험이 필요해요. AI 도구를 활용해 인프라 자동화 코드를 개발하고, 결과를 검증하여 운영 업무를 개선한 경험이 필요해요. 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요 오픈소스 기반 네트워크 모니터링 솔루션에 친숙하거나, 관련 개발 경험이 있으면 더 좋아요. 국내외 다양한 인터넷 서비스 사업자(ISP) 및 클라우드 사업자와 협력하여 멀티 데이터센터 연동 및 회선 로드밸런싱 구축 경험이 있으면 더 좋아요. NETWORK OVERLAY 기술(ACI, VXLAN, EVPN, MP-BGP, IS-IS, Fabric 등) 대해 높은 이해도를 갖추고, 구축 및 운영 경험이 있다면 좋아요 클라우드 네트워크 구축 및 최적화한 경험이 있으면 더 좋아요. 이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요 경력 기술서에는 기술적인 문제 개선 (최적화, 오류 수정 등) 사례 중 가장 기억에 남는 것을 기술해 주세요. 본인이 기여한 프로젝트를 사례 중심으로 상세히 기술해 주세요. (프로젝트 기간, 수행한 역할, 사용했던 기술 스택, 프로젝트 전후 개선된 점 등) 네트워크업무 향상을 위한 다양한 시도와 실패사례를 기반으로 본인의 역량을 발전시킨 경험이 있으면 기술해 주세요. 다루셨던 장비의 벤더를 상세히 기술해 주세요. 토스증권으로의 합류여정 서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사 꼭 확인해 주세요 이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. 토스증권 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요 함께할 동료를 위한 한마디 “토스증권에서는 상반된 두 가지 환경(제약이 많은 금융 인프라, IT기업의 트렌디한 모바일 서비스)을 모두 경험할 수 있어요!” 대한민국의 금융 인프라는 제약이 많기 때문에 해볼 수 있는 경험의 폭이 좁다고 생각해요. 토스증권에서는 비즈니스에 도움이 된다면 스스로 책임과 권한을 가지고 솔루션을 도입할 수 있어서 값진 경험을 해보고 있습니다. 보통의 네트워크 인프라라면 위에서 정해져서 내려오는 의미 없는 솔루션을 도입하는 경우들도 많은데요. 토스증권에서는 이러한 일들 없이, 다른 팀원의 공감을 얻고 가장 효율적인 것을 시도해 볼 수 있다는 점도 합리적이에요. 또한 내부적으로 정보 공유가 투명하게 되고 있기 때문에 다른 팀의 업무와 서비스 오픈 과정을 잘 이해할 수 있다는 것도 큰 장점입니다. 이러한 과정들을 통해 네트워크 엔지니어로서 제 커리어도 잘 발전시켜 가고 있어요. 스스로 책임과 권한을 가지고 업무하고 싶으신 분, 인프라를 운영해보고 싶으신 분들이라면 후회하지 않으실 거예요.
